sentences.text: The parents' room stayed below 18.0 °C all night, with the coldest reading being 16.5 °C at 00:00.
The bathroom also stayed below 18.0 °C, reaching 17.7 °C at 05:10.
Since both rooms were below 18.0 °C, please remember that the WHO recommends at least 18 °C indoors in cold seasons.
Perhaps checking the heating might help keep things cozy.
